articles.title: Yemeni government launches offensive to seize all areas from Iran-backed Houthis
articles.summary: Yemen’s Saudi-backed government said on Sunday it was launching a major military campaign to recapture all areas controlled by the Iran-backed Houthis.

articles.title: Yemeni government to launch military campaign to reclaim Houthi-controlled territory
articles.summary: Yemen's internationally recognised government will launch military operations in a bid to recover Houthi-controlled territory, the Yemeni Presidential Leadership Council chair Rashad al-Alimi has confirmed. Al-Alimi announced in a televised address on Sunday "the start of military operations to recover what remains of the Republic’s lands and to extend the authority of the state and its institutions".
